_doc: Budgets for the packed car GLBs in public/models, checked by tools/models/build-all.mjs and tests/client/modelBudgets.test.ts. Triangles and primitives include the hidden surfboard accessory. Mobile tier low (iPhone 12/13): <=150 draw calls incl. shadow pass and <=500k triangles for the whole frame; there the other players' cars use LOD1 with the wheels baked into the body (ModelCache staticWheelLods) or LOD2 from 14 m, and cast no shadow (4 or 3 draw calls per car, checked with seven cars in view by tests/e2e/world-look.spec.ts). modelTriangles: stricter per-model triangle limits for the cars after the T1 (LOD0 20k, LOD1 7k, LOD2 2k).
